## Problem
A worker is paid one seventh of a gold bar for each day of a seven-day week, at the end of every day. You may cut the bar only twice. Where do you cut so that you can pay every day?

## Hints
1. You can take pieces back as change. *(asked by Aramayis)*

## Solution
Cut the bar into pieces of $\tfrac17$, $\tfrac27$ and $\tfrac47$. Any whole number of sevenths from 1 to 7 is a sum of these three, like writing it in binary: day 1 give $\tfrac17$; day 2 give $\tfrac27$ and take back $\tfrac17$; day 3 give $\tfrac17$; day 4 give $\tfrac47$ and take back the rest; and so on.

## Notes
Aramayis tried cutting it into equal pieces and ran out of cuts.
